meta.title: Pairs — a calm tile game without ads
meta.description: Take pairs of matching tiles off the table until it is empty. Every layout can be finished; hints, undo and shuffle are free. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; works offline.

home.first: Take pairs of the same picture off the table until it is empty.

game.tip: Tap two free tiles with the same picture. A tile is free when nothing lies on it and its left or right side is open.
game.stuck: No pairs to take. Shuffle the tiles or undo a move.
game.covered: {picture} is blocked: another tile lies on it.
game.shuffleFailed: The tiles could not be shuffled. Undo a move and try again.

hint.pair: Take the two highlighted tiles ({picture}): after them the table can still be cleared.
hint.any: The highlighted tiles ({picture}) can be taken; the game could not look further ahead.

stuck.one: From here the table cannot be cleared. Undo {n} move, or shuffle the tiles.
stuck.other: From here the table cannot be cleared. Undo {n} moves, or shuffle the tiles.

hint.stuckFar: From here the table cannot be cleared. Shuffle the tiles, or undo several moves.

streak.one: Layouts of the day: {n} day in a row
streak.other: Layouts of the day: {n} days in a row

settings.resetSure: Tap again to clear levels, results and statistics

about.title: About the game
about.rules: Tiles lie on the table in layers. A tile is free when nothing lies on it, not even by a corner, and its left or right side is open. Tap two free tiles with the same picture and they are taken off. The layout is done when the table is empty. Every layout can be finished; hints, undo and shuffle have no limits.
about.text: Pairs without ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on this device. Works offline.
about.keys: Keyboard: arrows — move between free tiles, Enter or Space — choose, H — hint, Ctrl+Z — undo, S — shuffle, Esc — remove the choice or close.
